verdict.rationale: Kimi documents its own web search in the CLI and IDE agents, lists search and Deep Research as features of the assistant, and one hands-on report shows Thinking mode pulling information from Wikipedia. That covers grounding in current web results. No evidence shows the answers carry citations linking back to their sources. missing for 10: documented source citations/attribution in answers, in-depth docs on assistant web search and Deep Research behavior, independent corroboration of grounded and cited answers.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can get answers grounded in current web results with citations back to the sources
